structure_score: lag-1 Pearson correlation of consecutive eligible non-overlapping N-day block means
parent_local_p: (1 + number of finite matched-null scores greater than or equal to observed score) / 128; requires all 127 registered children finite
parent_robust_z: (observed score - median null score) / max(1.4826*median absolute deviation of null scores, 1e-12)
UI: fraction of eligible parents whose parent-local p is at most 0.05
NSS: median parent robust z across eligible parents
population_sign_p: exact one-sided Binomial(m,0.5) tail for the count of eligible parents with observed score strictly greater than their null median; ties count as not positive
SEP: eligible parent count at least 10 AND UI at least 0.50 AND NSS at least 2.0 AND within-condition Holm-adjusted population sign p at most 0.05
T_e: minimum N in the primary grid with baseline linear-adjacency SEP true; otherwise NOT_OBSERVED; never backfilled from winner_N
S_e_family_survival_at_N: baseline SEP is true and at least four of five nonbaseline primary-survival perturbations have SEP true at the same N
S_e_region: maximal consecutive sequence in the primary N grid beginning exactly at T_e for which S_e_family_survival_at_N is true; empty if the rule fails at T_e
S_e_contiguous: SEP-true eligible cell count divided by all eligible cells in the Cartesian product of the S_e region and six primary-survival conditions; zero when T_e is NOT_OBSERVED or the region is empty
AUC_SEP: SEP-true eligible cell count divided by all eligible cells over the full primary N grid and six primary-survival conditions
maximum_contiguous_N_survival: largest number of consecutive primary N values satisfying S_e_family_survival_at_N anywhere on the primary grid
perturbation_family_survival_rate: fraction of the five nonbaseline primary-survival perturbations with SEP true at T_e; NOT_APPLICABLE when T_e is not observed
failure_region_fraction: registered endpoint cells that are failed or ineligible divided by all registered endpoint cells
winner_N_parent: N on the specificity grid minimizing the frozen normalized lag closure error; smaller N breaks an exact tie
winner_N_study: mode of eligible parent winner_N labels; smaller N breaks a frequency tie
per_parent_T_e: first primary N with local p at most 0.05 and robust z at least 2.0; descriptive and uncorrected
per_parent_S_e: fraction of consecutive primary N values from per-parent T_e through the first later local-gate failure that pass the local p and robust-z gates; descriptive and uncorrected
